parent.p76_caveat: Historical learned write gate improved FIT/VAL, but explicit contradiction feature necessity NOT demonstrated by post-hoc ablation.

hypothesis: Under matched factual action/effect access, fixed 16-float fast-state and one causal-effect update after every observation, a directional-contradiction boost (not mere surprise) improves adaptation after an unseen selected-action causal reversal without unacceptable stable-world or cold A-return loss, and benefit vanishes when directional information is removed.

source.sequence: For each phase visit roles 0,1,2,3 four times; public role and observed post-action 4D terminal effect, separately observed noncausal proxy 4D. Only confirmed selected factual effects update fast state.
source.regimes: Every world has law A (4 action-conditioned 4D terminal effect vectors) sampled independently with reproducible Gaussian amplitudes. Half DEV/FIT stable A-A-A; half intervention A-B-A with B reversing terminal effects for roles 0,1, leaving roles 2,3 unchanged. Regime identity and change points evaluator only.
source.observation: At each executed public one-hot action, pre-update predict terminal effect from W@action; then observe terminal effect=selected law vector+Gaussian noise std 0.05 and noncausal proxy independent noise std 0.7. Never include proxy in write residual.
source.resampling: Independent source seeds for FIT and DEV, disjoint world draws; identical model-visible action/effect streams for all arms, no future-effect/label/phase flag or hidden regime input.
source.negative: PROXY_NEGATIVE is isolated DEV diagnostic with independent proxy amplitude 3.0 and same terminal causal law; thresholds frozen from FIT only, no learning on DEV.
source.protected_OOD: NONE GENERATED OR ACCESSED; no external simulator or independent scientific first-use.

memory.rule: For executed role k: prediction W[:,k]; after confirmed terminal goal effect y, W[:,k] += gain*(y-prediction); all arms execute one update per observed action, no hidden memory bank.
memory.contradiction: base gain 0.25 plus 0.5 if cosine(prediction,observed_goal)<-0.25 and norm(prediction)>=0.25. No phase/time/hidden state input.
memory.surprise: base gain 0.25 plus 0.5 if norm(observed_goal-prediction)>FIT-only threshold giving matching FIT fraction of boosted writes; threshold frozen before DEV.
memory.random: base gain 0.25 plus 0.5 for SHA256-driven independent random selector with probability equal FIT contradiction boost fraction, seed scoped per world/action; no privileged phase.
memory.ablated: base gain 0.25 plus 0.5 if absolute cosine(prediction,observed_goal)>0.25 (direction removed), FIT-only threshold matching contradiction boost fraction; separate diagnostic.
memory.information: Same public actions and confirmed terminal effects; all arms observe all events. Proxy never enters any arm.
memory.budgets: Same 16 persistent fast scalars and exactly 48 rank-one write operations per episode. Different selector overhead and boosted fractions measured; no unsupported equal-FLOP or matched trained-parameter assertion.

scoring.principal: Pre-observation prediction squared error at each factual selected action, never evaluate on post-update prediction for same event.
metrics: mean B-phase changed roles MSE for intervention worlds
mean A-return first visit per role pre-update MSE
world-bootstrap confidence interval of paired candidate-minus-strongest-control B MSE
boosted counts, wall-clock and memory/operation counts
scoring.calibration: Compute surprise threshold and random boost probability only on FIT from fixed all_write_eta_0.5 pre-update goal residual trace; contradiction boost rate from same FIT trace; no DEV threshold search.
scoring.seed_world_controls: Both stable and switched balanced exactly 50% in each split; role order and world identity unavailable to models; actual goal effect sign/identity differs under intervention.
scoring.failure: If any required DEV check fails, record DEV_NO_GO, preserve all scores, do NOT tune DEV, claim mechanism necessity, or open independent scientific evaluation from this evidence.
scoring.success: DEV_MECHANISM_SIGNAL_ONLY. A distinct preregistered fresh-world trained Hybrid/TTT comparison and protected original first-use authorization remains necessary for SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
